title: Stated metrics report (RFC 0083, RFC 0099, RFC 0115)
description: What `verify-metrics <file> --json` prints (Protocol §II.6a.1): every numeric statement of the document's dictionary metrics, checked against the metric dictionary (§II.2 item 2). Mirrors StatedMetricsReport in @uwmd/verify's protocol.ts.

rule_set.description: The record's declared Format version the statements were checked under (Protocol §XII.5, RFC 0111 D5).

path.description: Where the document states it, e.g. quick_metrics.dscr or valuation[base].cap_rate.

computed.description: The recomputed value at the comparison precision; null when unverifiable.

reason.description: Why the statement could not be checked; calc refusals carry their CALC-* code.
